The '''Bronze Trophy Fishing Sack''' is an {{Uncommon}} [[Sack]] that holds {{Green|512}} of each {{DG|Bronze}} [[Trophy Fish]]. 

== Obtaining ==
The '''Bronze Trophy Fishing Sack''' can be obtained as a reward for reaching [[Odger#Novice Trophy Fisher|Novice Trophy Fisher]], and can be bought from [[Odger]] for {{C|1m}} after reaching the milestone.

== Usage ==
The '''Bronze Trophy Fishing Sack''' can store {{Dark Gray|Bronze}} [[Trophy Fish]].
